_comment: Copy to conf/guardrail.json to override the defaults. Every field is optional.
_mode: enforce = block critical + redact high | redact = mask everything | audit = log only | off = disabled. The A0_GUARDRAIL_MODE env var wins over this file.
_allowlist: literal strings that must never be flagged, e.g. a published company contact address
_disabled_detectors: detector keys to switch off, e.g. ["postal_jp"]
_tools: tool names by egress class; unknown tools and MCP tools (server.tool) default to network
